title: Paloma and the Cipher
premise: When the coffin of town founder Aurelio Vance is exhumed for a centennial ceremony and found empty, concierge Marguerite Marchetti recognizes the grave-robber's gait from her hotel's security footage — and realizes the theft is tied to three 'accidental' deaths she quietly solved years ago. Following a cipher hidden in the hotel's original guest ledger, which Vance himself wrote, Marguerite discovers he faked his death to flee partners who were laundering money through the town, and that those heirs have been killing anyone who remembered too much. In the end, Marguerite decodes the ledger's final entry revealing where Vance actually lies buried, chooses loyalty to the dead man's memory over the heirs' hush money, and hands the truth to the one honest detective — letting the statute expire on the old crimes but not on the murders.
about_author: X. M. Coldharbour is the pen name of a former night auditor who spent a decade watching strangers check in and out of grand old hotels. They write mysteries about the people who notice everything and are noticed by no one.

chapters.title: The Empty Guest
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. During centennial preparations, the founder's coffin is opened and found empty; Marguerite recognizes the night watchman's limping gait in the footage and realizes he checked out an hour before the dig. Emotional beat: quiet dread as her private talent for noticing becomes impossible to keep private.

chapters.title: Ledger of Small Debts
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. She finds Vance's handwriting woven into the hotel's 1924 guest ledger — initials, room rates, dates forming a cipher — and connects it to the three deaths she once solved alone. The watchman is found drowned before he can talk. Emotional beat: grief and resolve; the past refuses to stay filed away.

chapters.title: What the Heirs Buried
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV, with interludes from Detective Ilsa Reyes. The Vance heirs offer Marguerite money and veiled threats; she decodes enough of the ledger to learn Vance staged his death and hid evidence of their laundering. Her found family at the hotel shelters her when her room is ransacked. Emotional beat: loyalty tested — take the money, or finish what the dead man started.

chapters.title: The Last Rate Charged
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. The final cipher entry names the orchard vault where Vance truly rests with his evidence; the heirs corner her there, but Reyes arrives, having followed the same ledger trail. One heir confesses to the murders; the statute spares the old crimes but not the new ones. Emotional beat: bittersweet peace — truth costs everything except regret.
